name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim VR

boot.about: boot to the main menu with no keys sent; the shortest startup and AOT-coverage check

helgen.about: new game to the Helgen cart intro with pad A pressed every 2 s from 6 s to 140 s (tools/play_skyrim_dev.sh --helgen)

summary.en: Runs on the Mac dev host (strict AOT, xrizer, keyboard dev controllers); no physical-headset playtest recorded by this harness

notes: The harness launches tools/play_skyrim_dev.sh (Mac, strict AOT, xrizer dev host, seeded prefs, keyboard dev controllers) and reads tools/vxrt_native_startup.py's evidence; it is a diagnostic development host, not SteamVR and not a headset.
Baselines are floors from dev-host runs (60 pairs/s is the host rate), not a playability claim. Only a human physical-headset playtest establishes playable (AGENTS.md).
Saves are isolated per run (runs/<id>/saves); the player's saves under build/private/saves/611670 are never used by the harness.
